name: Dread
summary:
DREAD
A Virtual Reality Horror Game
From the developers of the hit games "Static" and "Static Replayed".

You're a Gump, an ancient race of monkey-like beings whose numbers have suddenly and mysteriously declined. Your objective is to find the source of the extinction of the Gump and escape terrifying horror levels, ranging from an underground mine infested by an amalgam to a lost ancient civilization guarded by a fellow Gump corrupted by a mysterious force.
